daily.title: For foreign nationals in Japan, are rent hike notices take it or leave it?
daily.summary: Some accept the inevitability of having to pay higher rents due to inflation. Others find the extra financial burden frustrating amid stagnant wages.

daily.title: In war-split Myanmar, ‘spirit consorts’ commune across divide
daily.summary: At the annual Taungbyone Festival, the dazzling mediums drank, danced and swooned as they communed with the 111 divine ghosts of ancient Burmese folk religion

daily.title: Colin Kaepernick calls out ‘disingenuous’ NFL 10 years after taking knee in protest
daily.summary: In a rare interview, the former San Francisco 49ers quarterback said the NFL's statements condemning racial injustice after the 2020 death of George Floyd had been "laughable."

daily.title: Scientists make potential breakthrough in search for dark matter
daily.summary: Researchers in South Dakota observed hints of it during a deep-underground experiment but stopped short of saying they finally detected this elusive cosmic component.

daily.title: The Japanese idealist behind the only foreign deradicalization program in Somalia
daily.summary: With Washington and other donors reducing much of their aid to Somalia, Yosuke Nagai's agency has effectively become the only foreign-run one still working on deradicalization.

daily.title: Driven by faith, activists stand up to fellow Jews to protect Palestinians
daily.summary: A small movement of Israelis, many of them religious Jews, periodically go to the occupied West Bank to protect Palestinians under growing assault by violent settlers.

daily.title: Coco Gauff and Elena Rybakina cruise into second round at U.S. Open
daily.summary: World No. 2 Rybakina and No. 4 Gauff are two of the three players, along with No. 3 Jessica Pegula, who have a chance to supplant Aryna Sabalenka atop the world rankings.

daily.title: BOJ’s Ueda hints at September rate hike as bets on move mount
daily.summary: Expectations have also been fueled by a slew of comments by U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent hinting at the need for action.

daily.title: Bank of America vice president killed in Manhattan stabbing
daily.summary: Erin Piacenti — who was a vice president of business selection and conflicts at the bank, according to a LinkedIn profile — died at the hospital from the stabbing injuries.

daily.title: Rams owner Stan Kroenke reaches deal to acquire MLB’s Angels
daily.summary: Kroenke already owns the NFL's Los Angeles Rams, the NBA's Denver Nuggets, the NHL's Colorado Avalanche, MLS club Colorado Rapids, and Arsenal of the Premier League.

daily.title: Xi returns to transformed Middle East for first Egypt visit in 10 years
daily.summary: The Chinese leader is coming back to a region convulsed by war and with U.S. economic weapons once again deployed against Tehran.

daily.title: Reviled in the U.S., data centers win support in Brazil’s presidential election
daily.summary: Both Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and rival Flavio Bolsonaro are making data centers central to their pitches to bolster Latin America's largest economy.

daily.title: Fish-fruit pairings catching on as novel way to spur demand
daily.summary: With fish consumption declining, particularly among younger people, one fish market official hopes pairing fish with fruit will give dishes a "sense of novelty and visual flair."

daily.title: Shelter for families with children opens after Kumamoto earthquake
daily.summary: The specialized evacuation shelter, which also caters to the needs of pregnant women, is the only one of its kind in Kumamoto.

daily.title: Over 900 Nepal students saved by call warning of flood and quick thinking
daily.summary: School's successful evacuation offers a rare glimmer of hope in a natural disaster that has killed over 900 people with thousands still missing.

daily.title: G20 finance chiefs — except China — back action on distorted trade
daily.summary: China's massive export push has pressured economies across the globe, especially as the U.S. has ​imposed high tariffs on Chinese goods.

daily.title: Matchmaking events for people with same surname emerge in Japan
daily.summary: Some are trying to circumvent Japan's surname rule for married couples by finding someone who already has the same last name.

daily.title: Healthy Victor Oladipo asks NBA teams for another chance
daily.summary: The 34-year-old guard penned an open letter to the league's general managers in The Players' Tribune on Tuesday, asking for an opportunity.

daily.title: Yamaguchi Financial to dump more Japan bonds on faster BOJ hikes
daily.summary: Banks and other investors are grappling with soaring bond yields as the central bank seeks to combat inflation in an economy that had previously seen prices sink for years.

daily.title: Kiki returns for a charming second act
daily.summary: Beloved witch Kiki is part of a series of books by Eiko Kadono. The second title in the series is out in English translation.

daily.title: The Soviet defection that exposed Japan’s security conundrum
daily.summary: A Soviet pilot's landing of a MiG-25 at Hakodate Airport was an 'intelligence bonanza' that also revealed gaps in Japan's defenses.

daily.title: Takaichi’s $640 billion AI gamble faces reality check in a struggling city
daily.summary: In Kitakami, a sleepy city deep in the countryside 500 kilometers north of Tokyo, Japan's AI revolution is unfolding more as a slow burn than a boom.

daily.title: Russian cybercrime operation being dismantled after two decades: U.S. and CrowdStrike
daily.summary: Though it has been overshadowed by more disruptive cybercriminals, the Russian hacking operation remains one of the internet's longest-running cybercriminal enterprises.

daily.title: Manchester City adds Enzo Fernandez to complete summer spending spree
daily.summary: The 25-year-old becomes the first player to be sold for more than £100 million twice in his career and will also be reunited with City coach Enzo Maresca.

daily.title: When AI does the thinking, what could possibly go wrong?
daily.summary: Bill Gates' message is simple: "Even under the best circumstances, the transition to this new AI era will be one of the most turbulent times in human history."

daily.title: Burnham says water central to U.K. plan for public control
daily.summary: Thames Water, which serves London and much of the surrounding region, is seen as the leading target for more direct government control, though the prime minister did not name it.

daily.title: U.S. urges hands-off approach to AI regulation at G20 tech meeting
daily.summary: The U.S. goals largely align with the thinking of the world's biggest artificial intelligence companies, nearly all of which are American.

daily.title: Germany blames Russia for airport drone incident, hits back with sanctions
daily.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin later branded the sanctions move as a "mistake."

daily.title: U.N. faces contentious Iran nuclear vote ahead of General Assembly
daily.summary: A vote raises the prospect of vetoes by both Russia and China, which argue that the Security Council no longer has a mandate to consider the Iranian nuclear issue.

daily.title: Putin says Russia is winning on battlefield, will not negotiate with ‘terrorists’
daily.summary: Russia controls about a fifth of Ukraine 4½ years after Moscow's invasion.
